title: Google's AI Just Math-Checked Signal's Encryption Code
description:
Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code used AI agents to write machine-checked math proofs about the core encryption code of Signal (announced Nov 10, 2026), down to machine code, in about four weeks.
As a test, two old, already-fixed Signal bugs were put back and the proofs showed those versions insecure. No new flaws were found, and it does not cover the whole app.
